data.exact_reserve_text:
There have been positive reserve movements in the year, on the 2017 and prior years of account.
In 2019 there has been an improvement of GBP 5.2m on closed year reserves, which makes up just over half of the result.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant deteriorations in reserves on the losses in Hawaii from lava flow (deterioration on Property binders).
Significant deteriorations in reserves from the California Wildfire losses (deterioration on Property binders).
Major large loss on the Aviation account (reported as a major large loss on the 2018 underwriting year to date).
Deterioration on Lion Mentari Airlines (Aviation), with further developments mitigated by reinsurance.

named_events.loss_description: The only catastrophe loss of note in the year was Hurricane Dorian which is estimated at GBP 7m (US$9m).
Significant deteriorations in reserves on the losses in Hawaii from lava flow.
Significant deteriorations in reserves on the California Wildfire losses.
A major large loss on the Aviation account (Ethiopian Airlines).
A deterioration on Lion Mentari Airlines (Aviation).

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 263.9m. During 2019 there was a material net release in prior year gross reserves of GBP 132.237m (a c.50% release relative to opening gross reserves), primarily reflecting favourable claims development on closed underwriting years (notably 2017 and prior). Individual impacts mentioned include reserve improvements on the 2017 year and positive prior-year development, while certain prior large property losses (Hawaii lava flow, California wildfires) and major aviation losses (Ethiopian Airlines, Lion Mentari) are noted elsewhere as causes of deterioration on specific years. The reported gross prior year movement (insurance liabilities column) is the primary source for the quantified release.
raw_causal_phrases: There have been positive reserve movements in the year, on the 2017 and prior years of account.
In 2019 there has been an improvement of GBP 5.2m on closed year reserves, which makes up just over half of the result.
The reserves set on the 2017 pure year of account at the end of last year have also proved robust, and we have experienced positive claims development.
There has been significant deteriorations in reserves on the losses in Hawaii from lava flow, and the California Wildfire losses.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior year movement taken directly from Technical Provisions note / Balance Sheet (gross claims outstanding and 'Change in prior year provisions' insurance liabilities column). Prior year development uses the gross insurance liabilities column (-132,237k). Claims development triangle is present (gross and net). RITC activity exists for closed years (notably 2017 RITC) which can distort development comparisons - triangle usage should account for RITC; some event-specific impacts are discussed qualitatively and are not quantified in the gross movement line. Minor rounding differences between balance sheet (263,908k) and technical note (263,909k) accounted for.
